textLines: Verantwortlicher: Bernardo Pingarrón, __CONTROLLER_EMAIL__
Ich willige ein, dass BarNerd mir per E-Mail Informationen zu den von mir
ausgewählten Themen sendet. Rechtsgrundlage ist Art. 6 Abs. 1 lit. a DSGVO.
Zur Auswahl stehen:
[ ] Beta des Recipe Managers
[ ] Beta von ROAST
[ ] Neuigkeiten zu BarNerd
Ich kann diese Einwilligung jederzeit ohne Angabe von Gründen formlos
widerrufen, per E-Mail an __CONTROLLER_EMAIL__. Der Widerruf wirkt für die
Zukunft. Danach lösche ich die E-Mail-Adresse; den Nachweis, dass und worin
ich eingewilligt habe, bewahre ich für die Dauer der gesetzlichen Fristen
(3 Jahre) auf, auf Grundlage von Art. 6 Abs. 1 lit. c und lit. f DSGVO.
Zur Bestätigung sende ich einmalig eine E-Mail mit einem Bestätigungslink
(Double-Opt-In). Diese Bestätigungs-E-Mail enthält keine Werbung. Erst nach
der Bestätigung sende ich weitere Nachrichten.
Weitere Informationen zu Empfängern, Speicherdauer und meinen Rechten:
Controller: Bernardo Pingarrón, __CONTROLLER_EMAIL__
I consent to BarNerd sending me email about the topics I select below. The
legal basis is Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR. The topics are:
[ ] Recipe Manager beta
[ ] ROAST beta
[ ] News about BarNerd
I can withdraw this consent at any time, without giving reasons, informally
by email to __CONTROLLER_EMAIL__. Withdrawal applies going forward. After
that I delete the address; I keep the proof of what I consented to for the
statutory limitation period (3 years), on the basis of Art. 6(1)(c) and (f)
GDPR.
To confirm, I send one email with a confirmation link (double opt-in). That
confirmation email contains no advertising. Only after confirmation do I send
further messages.
More information on recipients, retention and my rights:

_hashConvention: sha256 over textLines.join("\n"), UTF-8, no trailing newline. Computed by scripts/check-consent-ready.mjs; never authored by hand.
_versioningNote: v1, edited in place on 2026-10-12 — no v2 and no version registry. v1 never reached a data subject: add-waitlist-consent-evidence.sql had not been run, the consent_version column did not exist, and the code that writes it was undeployed, so no stored row points at the old wording and a registry would only describe versions nobody saw. Two things changed in the news topic: 'und dem Blog' / 'and the blog' is gone (it named a medium the notice already names — email), and labels.news follows the same edit. Nothing else in either block was touched; the wording is otherwise frozen. (The session-id sentence this pass also removes is NOT in these blocks — it was in the Art. 13 notice's list of collected data, src/legal/datenschutz.template.html section 2, DE and EN, and it is removed there, because the id is no longer written beside an address and the notice never gave a purpose for it.) The sha256 values were recomputed over the edited textLines and replaced in all four places that hold them: de/en.sha256 here, the $$-quoted seed in add-waitlist-consent-evidence.sql, FROZEN_SHA256 in scripts/build-bcb-standalone.mjs, and FROZEN_SHA256 in scripts/check-consent-ready.mjs. A future wording change still gets a new version instead of another edit here.
